mapper.select:
SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.code AS warehouseCode, w.name AS warehouseName, CONCAT_WS(',', 'WMS', IF(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.wms_sku_id = i.sku_id AND ps.wms_warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0 ), 'MALL', NULL), IF(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_item_sku ws ON ws.id = i.sku_id AND ws.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product ep ON ep.bar_code = ws.bar_code AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0 ), 'ERP', NULL) ) AS sourceSystems, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS wmsSkuCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.id) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.wms_sku_id = i.sku_id AND ps.wms_warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS mallSkuCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.id) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_item_sku ws ON ws.id = i.sku_id AND ws.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product ep ON ep.bar_code = ws.bar_code AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS erpProductCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS physicalQuantity, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ew.name ORDER BY ew.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM erp_warehouse ew WHERE ew.name = w.name AND ew.deleted = 0) AS relatedErpWarehouseNames, w.remark AS remark FROM wms_warehouse w WHERE w.deleted = 0
ORDER BY w.sort ASC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.code AS warehouseCode, w.name AS warehouseName, CONCAT_WS(',', 'WMS', IF(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.wms_sku_id = i.sku_id AND ps.wms_warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0 ), 'MALL', NULL), IF(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_item_sku ws ON ws.id = i.sku_id AND ws.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product ep ON ep.bar_code = ws.bar_code AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0 ), 'ERP', NULL) ) AS sourceSystems, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS wmsSkuCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.id) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.wms_sku_id = i.sku_id AND ps.wms_warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS mallSkuCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.id) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_item_sku ws ON ws.id = i.sku_id AND ws.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product ep ON ep.bar_code = ws.bar_code AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS erpProductCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS physicalQuantity, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ew.name ORDER BY ew.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM erp_warehouse ew WHERE ew.name = w.name AND ew.deleted = 0) AS relatedErpWarehouseNames, w.remark AS remark FROM wms_warehouse w WHERE w.deleted = 0
ORDER BY w.sort ASC, w.id DESC

) t
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wms_sku_id, wms_warehouse_id, MIN(id) AS mallSkuId FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = 0 AND wms_sku_id IS NOT NULL AND wms_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wms_sku_id, wms_warehouse_id ) mall_mapping ON mall_mapping.wms_sku_id = i.sku_id AND mall_mapping.wms_warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.id = mall_mapping.mallSkuId AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = ps.spu_id AND spu.deleted = 0

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bar_code, MIN(id) AS erpProductId FROM erp_product WHERE deleted = 0 AND bar_code IS NOT NULL AND bar_code != '' GROUP BY bar_code ) erp_mapping ON erp_mapping.bar_code = ws.bar_code LEFT JOIN erp_product ep ON ep.id = erp_mapping.erpProductId AND ep.deleted = 0

WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ws.deleted = 0 AND wi.deleted = 0 AND i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND wi.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{itemName}, '%')
AND ps.id IS NOT NULL
AND ep.id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT i.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, ws.id AS wmsSkuId, ws.name AS wmsSkuName, wi.id AS wmsItemId, wi.name AS wmsItemName, ws.bar_code AS barCode, i.quantity AS physicalQuantity, ps.id AS mallSkuId, spu.id AS mallSpuId, spu.name AS mallSpuName, ps.stock AS mallCachedStock, ep.id AS erpProductId, ep.name AS erpProductName FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN wms_item_sku ws ON ws.id = i.sku_id INNER JOIN wms_item wi ON wi.id = ws.item_id
ORDER BY wi.id ASC, ws.id ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN wms_item_sku ws ON ws.id = i.sku_id INNER JOIN wms_item wi ON wi.id = ws.item_id
